$comment: The threat zones of a release (tools/release/zones.ts, npx tsx tools/release/zones.ts [<base>] [<head>] [--all]): each zone names the paths that belong to it, the VM scenarios that exercise it on a fresh Mac and the persona walks and feature recipes of .claude/skills/verify that walk it. A changed file selects every zone whose paths match it; a file of no zone is quiet (no person walks it) or falls back to the install scenario (app code no zone names yet); anything else selects everything. Paths are globs (node:path matchesGlob) from the repository root. tests/release-zones.test.ts checks every glob matches a file, every tracked file has a place, every scenario, persona and feature exists and each is used.

install.title: Install and first start
install.how: npm run desktop:e2e -- --fresh (a throwaway clone of vanilla-clean: install, the smoke test through every area, new books, a restart). By hand on vm.sh up: the dmg, Gatekeeper, the move to Applications, Einrichtung and the start screen (features/desktop-install.md).

update.title: Update from the previous version
update.how: npm run desktop:e2e on the persistent VM vanilla-e2e: the new app goes over the previous one, as an update does, and opens the books the previous version wrote (a books format step migrates them once).

permissions.title: macOS asks for access after the app's words
permissions.how: vm.sh up (fresh): «Neue Buchhaltung anlegen» › «Weiter» in Documents: the app's words come first, then macOS asks; refuse once and read the app's text; drop a file from Downloads (#373, SKILL.md Gotchas).

setup.title: New books through setup
setup.how: vm.sh up (fresh) or --from huber-setup: «Neue Buchhaltung anlegen», the form with the persona's UID and IBAN, the setup conversation, then read the written belege.workspace.yaml in the VM (features/desktop-setup.md).

statement-import.title: A bank statement into the packed app
statement-import.how: vm.sh up --from huber-setup: drop $PERSONA_CAMT (and the CSV the bank offers first): the account is recognised, the payments show in Kontoauszüge, the balance check holds (features/desktop-drop.md).

receipt-drop.title: Receipts dropped into the packed app
receipt-drop.how: vm.sh up --from huber-setup: drop the persona's supplier PDFs, a till photo, the duplicate and the wrong files: taken, read, linked to their payment, the duplicate and the wrong file refused, «Rückgängig» (features/desktop-drop.md).

ai-sidebar.title: Booking with Claude Code in the packed app
ai-sidebar.how: vm.sh up --from huber-q3, vm.sh claude, vm.sh app: the app finds Claude Code, a receipt is read and booked, ⌘J takes a wish and the books show it (features/ai-sidebar.md).

vat-return.title: A return filed, with its XML
vat-return.how: vm.sh up --from huber-q3: «Abrechnung erstellen» › the task «Abrechnung <q> prüfen» › «Freigegeben» › «Eingereicht»: the XML saved where the person chose, filings/ holds it and seal-<q>.json, closedThrough moved (features/README.md, Not mapped yet).

year-close.title: The year close
year-close.how: vm.sh up --from huber-q3, the year's last quarter filed: Abschluss through its steps; closedThrough reaches 31.12., the next year opens with its opening balances (features/close-and-company.md).

invoicing.title: An invoice with its PDF and mail
invoicing.how: vm.sh up --from huber-q3: Rechnungen › a new invoice, «Ausstellen»: the PDF printed by the packed browser with its QR-bill, «Senden» opens Mail with the PDF attached (features/invoices.md).

share-link.title: Sharing by link, opened on another Mac
share-link.how: Two VMs: on the sharer's, vm.sh sender and vm.sh app, «Teilen» › «Per Link»; on a fresh second VM the link (clicked, and pasted under «Einen Link bekommen?») opens the books (SKILL.md, Sharing by link).

share-update.title: «Aktualisieren» keeps the recipient's change
share-update.how: After share-link: the recipient changes something; the sharer changes the books and «Aktualisieren»: the recipient gets the new state and still has her change.

share-return.title: A return of the recipient's changes
share-return.how: After share-link: the recipient sends her changes back; the sharer's card shows «Rücksendung abgeholt», the Durchsicht takes or refuses each change.

share-withdraw.title: «Zurückziehen»
share-withdraw.how: After share-link: the sharer's «Zurückziehen»: the service deletes the share; the recipient's app says it was withdrawn and offers the return as a file only.

file-open.title: A .vanilla file double-clicked on a fresh Mac
file-open.how: A fresh VM that never opened books: vm.sh put <books>.vanilla, double-click it in Finder (vm.sh dclick, or vm.sh sh 'open ~/Downloads/<books>.vanilla'): the app starts and opens it.
